scenes.title: Becoming One Creature Again
scenes.summary: Kuroki tells Muranishi he is finished and proposes faking her death to launch a new religious group together—with him as founder and her as shrine maiden—before whispering farewell when he refuses.

scenes.title: Thank You for Making Me Kaoru Kuroki
scenes.summary: Over drinks at home, Kuroki thanks her makeup artist and roommate for casting the spell that turned her into Kaoru Kuroki; while her friend steps out for ice cream, Kuroki recalls Muranishi naming her and slips from the balcony.

scenes.title: Just Under One Hundred Million Left
scenes.summary: As paramedics rush an unconscious Kuroki into intensive care, Furuya and his deputy beat Muranishi over his remaining hundred-million-yen debt until Muranishi claims there is money left at Kawada's company.
scenes.location: emergency hospital corridor and Furuya office

scenes.title: Times Change
scenes.summary: Police brass inaugurate a task force for the new anti-yakuza law; outside headquarters, a bruised Muranishi offers Detective Takei half his sales to arrest his attackers, only for Takei to laugh that Muranishi is finished.
scenes.location: police headquarters briefing room and courtyard

scenes.title: Obscenity Standards Have Changed
scenes.summary: Kawada and Toshi promise the video chain Proprietor they will never touch black-market bootlegs, and the Proprietor unveils newly legal "hair nude" photo books—moving Kawada to tears as Kuroki's dream takes shape.

scenes.title: Beyond the Mosaic
scenes.summary: Spotting their former junior director working at the shop counter, Kawada and Toshi accept the Proprietor's offer to produce original videos for his store chain and vow to show viewers what lies beyond the mosaic.
scenes.location: adult video shop counter and back room

scenes.title: I Could Never Surpass Kaoru Kuroki
scenes.summary: Returning to the graffiti-covered office to collect her bags, Muranishi's new star admits her life plans are in ruins yet says she does not regret coming—confessing she could never surpass Kaoru Kuroki.

scenes.title: Stay Away from Her Now
scenes.summary: Mobbed by tabloid reporters at the hospital after Kuroki's fall makes front-page news, Muranishi is confronted in tears by Kuroki's friend for trampling on her trust while Kuroki's mother Kayo prays at her bedside.
scenes.location: hospital entrance and intensive care ward

scenes.title: Were You Going to Sell Them Underground?
scenes.summary: While Kawada's reunited crew celebrates a promising new shoot, a desperate Muranishi breaks into their office safe to steal master tapes—only to be caught red-handed by Kawada, Toshi, and their junior director.

scenes.title: Do You Prefer Summer or Winter?
scenes.summary: Hanging Muranishi upside down in a freezing warehouse, Furuya reminisces about the cold day they first met and offers a final smoke before ordering him dismembered—until Muranishi breaks loose and bolts into the street.

scenes.title: Shouldering Muranishi's Debt
scenes.summary: Furuya's deputy raids Kawada's studio, seizes their master tapes, and saddles the entire crew with Muranishi's two-billion-yen debt; at lights-out outside the hospital, Toshi pulls up beside Muranishi and tells him to get in.
scenes.location: Kawada's studio and street outside the hospital
